heroHeadline: Gabbard's Declassified Fauci Files and Rand Paul's Subpoena Reignite Origins Fight — FDA, EMA Target XFG for Next Vaccine
heroSubtitle: Outgoing DNI Tulsi Gabbard released declassified documents on June 18 alleging Fauci suppressed lab-leak intelligence; independent reviews dispute the claim. Sen. Rand Paul subpoenaed Fauci on June 22 to testify July 29. FDA (May 28) and EMA (May 29) both recommended XFG as the antigen for 2026-2027 COVID vaccines. WHO's IGWG resumed PABS annex talks on July 6, with outcomes now pushed to the 2027 World Health Assembly.
footerNote: Data sourced from WHO, CDC, Our World in Data, The Lancet, Johns Hopkins CSSE, IMF, IATA, ILO, UNICEF, NIH RECOVER, Nature Immunology, FDA, EMA
